status: DRAFT, unsigned, nothing run, no data after the cut exists yet
needs_new_code: loader for the perp-live-data files book.csv, book_fast.csv, markets.csv, coverage files (audited once, wall first)
event scorer plugin: episode detection, next-quote entry, hold exit, taker and maker columns, margin view, hand case first

closest_existing: PERPDEPTH1 F1 (top-5 book imbalance, holds 5 to 60 minutes)
uniqueness.difference: touch only (level 1 sizes, not the 5 level sum), a scalping horizon of 1 to 5 minutes, and a 5 second sampling arm that PERPDEPTH1 does not have; the signal is a resting-size imbalance, not price history
uniqueness.overlap_disclosed: the feature is the level-1 slice of PERPDEPTH1 F1; the two are different holds and sampling, but the same hypothesis family: a survivor of either is checked for correlation with the other (0.3 or more = duplicate, 7d) before it is called unique; the Head ruled it a separate lane, not a version

counterparty: the liquidity providers on the THIN side of the touch: a resting quote that is the only size left is picked off or repriced after the next taker order; a taker that follows the imbalance trades against makers who do not reprice fast enough (adverse selection, their loss). If instead the thick side is stale or spoofed, the fade is the other side of that.

data.source: perp-live-data branch: ARM F = book_fast.csv (5 second batched book, 14:30 to 21:00 UTC Monday to Friday, ten tickers of which the five below); ARM S = book.csv (60 second book, all hours) with markets.csv for the quote and marks

Every perplive/<date>/<HHMM> folder whose job STARTED before that instant, i.e. all files of the 2026-11-16 18:18 UTC job (it ran the old code to its 22:00Z boundary and its book.csv holds the five FAR levels), is dropped by the loader and counted; the first usable job is the first one started after 21:16:29Z. Main records the first usable directory stamp here on the first fixed file; the first FULL UTC day after it is the start day.

split.start_utc_check: 2026-11-17T00:00:00Z (provisional: the first full UTC day after the first fixed file; moves only by a dated amendment before any outcome is joined)
split.first_read_check: 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z (10 trade days after the start day: 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-30 weekdays)
split.release_rule: one read per rule; a rule under 100 entries at the first read prints 'no evidence at n = x' and is read once more on 2026-12-21; a rule with n >= 100 is never re-read

holds.label: H16 perps (KXUS500PERP, KXUSTECH100PERP among them)
holds.handling: last decision 1797811200 = 2026-12-21T00:00Z, the longest hold is 5 minutes

feature.I1: (bid_sz_1 - ask_sz_1) / (bid_sz_1 + ask_sz_1) from the book row at the decision poll; two sided top required (0 < bid_px_1 < ask_px_1, both sizes > 0), else skipped and counted
direction: follow: long when I1 >= T, short when I1 <= -T

episodes: a signal is the first poll at which the condition holds after being false for at least 3 polls; one position per name and rule at a time; ENTRY at the first recorded quote after the decision poll (buy at the ask, sell at the bid) from the same arm's own data, EXIT at the first quote at or after entry + hold; a gap of more than 2 polls at the exit voids the trade and counts; an event whose hold spans a funding print is dropped and counted

grid.rules_formula: 5 markets x 3 thresholds x 2 directions x 4 holds x 2 arms
grid.subset_rationale: the whole stated grid, thresholds chosen from the scale of the feature, no outcome used

costs.taker: net per trade in bps of entry notional after crossing the touch both ways, minus a round trip fee of 5 bps and, as the harsh line, 12 bps (the Head's scenarios; Kalshi's published perps fee is still to be written in; every figure 'fee assumed, not a result')
costs.maker_column: the same trades with the ENTRY at the own side of the touch (no spread crossed on entry) and a taker exit; fee 5 and 12 bps round trip as above; maker fills are NOT modelled, so the column is an upper bound: a rule that passes ONLY here is FLAGGED 'maker-only' and is NOT counted as a pass
costs.margin_view: for f = 10, 25 and 50 percent of the page max leverage of the name (PERPS_PAGE_MAX_20261116.tsv sha 5be707ec: BTC 15.4, ETH 10.5, gold 40, US Tech 100 28.9, US 500 36.1), return on margin = net bps x f x page max, and the path based liquidation test with d_liq = (1/f - 1)/L_max (a conservative maintenance assumption to be checked), the worst recorded mid against the position decides; reported beside price terms, never instead

gates.pf_note: PF 1.3 at the 5 bps taker line and 1.0 at 12 bps
gates.signals_per_day_note: entries per active day of the name, for ARM F only the days with a fast window (weekdays), for ARM S every UTC day with data; both gates are on the rule, so a 60 s rule needs 3 a day from 60 s polls
gates.p: one sided, day clustered (UTC date of entry), taker 5 bps net

tries.prior_m: for a print today 6,290,660 + 240 = 6,290,900; from 2026-11-17 on 7,492,484 + 240 = 7,492,724 (carried numbers by the Head and Auditor B; Auditor B confirms on Nov 17)

prediction: numeric: the mean mid move over the next 1 to 5 minutes after |I1| >= 0.9 is under 0.5 bps in every market (spread 0.5 bps, fee 5 bps); expected PF at the 5 bps taker line below 1.0 in at least 4 of 5 markets; probability that any rule passes PF 1.3 at 5 bps with 3 a day and 100 entries about 3 percent; a maker-only pass is likely and is not counted
kill: drop the family if at the first read the PF at the 5 bps taker line is under 1.0 in at least 4 of 5 markets in BOTH arms, or if fewer than 3 entries a day are reached by any rule in both arms
